ozokerite: n a waxy mineral that is a mixture of hydrocarbons and occurs in association with petroleum; some varieties are used in making ceresin and candles
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">德語 ozokerit，源自 ozo-（源自希臘語，意為惡臭，源自 ozein“發出氣味”）＋ker-（cer-）＋-it（-ite）</dd></dl>
ozone:
n. 新鮮的空氣, 臭氧, 使人愉快的影響
[化] 臭氧

n. a colorless gas (O3) soluble in alkalis and cold water; a strong oxidizing agent; can be produced by electric discharge in oxygen or by the action of ultraviolet radiation on oxygen in the stratosphere (where it acts as a screen for ultraviolet radiation)
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>「臭氧」義是化學用語；「海邊清新空氣」義字典標為主要英式、口語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>德語 ozon，源自希臘 ozein「發出氣味」，因臭氧有特殊氣味而得名</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>ozone depletion；ozone-friendly</dd></dl>
ozonide: n any of a class of unstable chemical compounds resulting from the addition of ozone to a double bond in an unsaturated compound
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 ozon-＋-ide；最初以德語 ozonid 形式構成</dd></dl>
ozonize:
vi. 變成臭氧
vt. 以臭氧處理, 使含臭氧
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 ozon-＋-ize</dd></dl>
